versions.label: v22 LTS
versions.installScript: curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz -o /tmp/node.tar.xz && tar -C /opt -xf /tmp/node.tar.xz && mv /opt/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64 /opt/node && ln -sf /opt/node/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node && ln -sf /opt/node/bin/npm /usr/local/bin/npm && ln -sf /opt/node/bin/npx /usr/local/bin/npx

versions.label: v20 LTS
versions.installScript: curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v20.18.0/node-v20.18.0-linux-x64.tar.xz -o /tmp/node.tar.xz && tar -C /opt -xf /tmp/node.tar.xz && mv /opt/node-v20.18.0-linux-x64 /opt/node && ln -sf /opt/node/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node && ln -sf /opt/node/bin/npm /usr/local/bin/npm && ln -sf /opt/node/bin/npx /usr/local/bin/npx
apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3.12 python3.12-venv python3-pip && ln -sf /usr/bin/python3.12 /usr/local/bin/python && ln -sf /usr/bin/python3.12 /usr/local/bin/python3
apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3.11 python3.11-venv python3-pip && ln -sf /usr/bin/python3.11 /usr/local/bin/python && ln -sf /usr/bin/python3.11 /usr/local/bin/python3

versions.label: 21 LTS
versions.installScript: apt-get update && apt-get install -y openjdk-21-jdk-headless maven && ln -sf /usr/bin/java /usr/local/bin/java

versions.label: 17 LTS
versions.installScript: apt-get update && apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk-headless maven && ln -sf /usr/bin/java /usr/local/bin/java
